applies_why: This judge text issues UNDERDETERMINED for Matthew 1:20 by treating its two readings as unresolved, so K-S2 applies.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that admits both readings is such a verse. It is not, if the judge names another verse or phrase that settles it.
room: if the judge names another verse or phrase that settles it — whether the judge must itself name the settling verse or phrase, or may instead cite other round labels that contain such verses.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED treats Matthew 1:20 as admitting both the covenant-presence and physical-source readings, but it cites only round labels rather than naming a verse or phrase that settles the matter.
